name: fresh-news feedback ON + hold-winners rebalancing
description: Design-fix arm: identical to fresh_news_feedback_on.json except rebalance_mode=hold, which trades only the delta instead of liquidating and re-sizing the whole book each period.
notes: WHY THIS EXISTS: across the 108 runs of the ON/OFF experiment the strategy lost
to INIT (its own period-0 book, never rebalanced) by ~8pp, at p=0.0001, in BOTH
arms. The cause is not stock-picking and not feedback. It is that every rebalance
liquidates 100% of the book and re-buys to fresh ~1/N target weights, which resets
any position that compounded. That truncates the right tail:
strategy  mean +38.65  sd 13.45  max  +76.28  skew +0.72
INIT      mean +46.85  sd 20.68  max +142.80  skew +1.88
upside capture when INIT landed in its BEST  quartile:  71%
upside capture when INIT landed in its WORST quartile: 107%
Rebalancing was acting as variance reduction on a right-skewed opportunity set,
which costs mean return. At 12x the effect is starkest: strategy sd 12.58 vs
INIT sd 24.71.
WHAT CHANGES: rebalance_mode=hold reads the model's weights as INTENT (which names
to own) and trades only the delta — sell what it dropped, buy what it added, and
leave kept positions completely alone so winners keep compounding. It does NOT
change the prompt, the candidate screen, the news, or the cadence.
NOT COMPARABLE to the 108 reset-mode runs as a controlled contrast — the execution
layer differs. The meaningful comparison is each run against its OWN INIT baseline
(vs_no_reinvest_pp), which is computed identically in both modes.
Feedback is ON to match fresh_news_feedback_on.json, so the only difference from
that arm is rebalance_mode.
